faq.q: What are AI shoe video templates?
faq.a: They turn your shoe photos into ready-to-post video ads with a voice, words, and product scenes. You do not need a model shoot or editing experience.

faq.q: Can I make versions for different shoe colors?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a photo of each color and make a separate ad for each pair. Try different openings without another shoot.

faq.q: Which kinds of shoes can I advertise?
faq.a: Use the templates for sneakers, sandals, work boots, dress shoes, heels, and more. Show the pair you sell and check its details before posting.

faq.q: Can beginners make a shoe video ad?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your shoe photo, choose a scene, and add a short message. You do not need video editing experience.

faq.q: Can I make several shoe ads from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Paste your product link and make versions with different scenes or openings. You can compare ads without filming each style.

faq.q: How do I make a shoe video ad?
faq.a: Upload a clear shoe photo, choose a scene, and add what you want said. You can make a video in a few minutes without filming.

faq.q: Can I use these shoe videos in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Download the shoe video without a watermark and use it on product pages, social media, or in paid ads.

faq.q: Who can use AI shoe ad templates?
faq.a: Shoe shops, sneaker brands, and small teams can make product ads without hiring models or a studio. Start with photos you already have.

faq.q: How fast can I make a shoe ad, and what does it cost?
faq.a: You can make a shoe ad in a few minutes. Videos cost 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30.
